variables.name: AUTH_MODE
variables.description: Zero-setup beta mode; switch to lakebed only after configuring the control-plane variables.

variables.name: LOCAL_DEMO_TOKEN
variables.description: Share this token privately with invited players, separately from the server URL.

variables.name: SERVER_ID
variables.description: Stable ID for this self-hosted server.

variables.name: PUBLIC_SERVER_NAME
variables.description: Name shown in health output and the Lakecraft server list.

variables.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated exact web origins permitted to open the WebSocket. Add localhost only for local development.

operatorNotes: Keep exactly one replica because the server uses one SQLite database and in-memory realtime state.
Do not enable Serverless App Sleeping for a multiplayer server.
The Railway template composer, not config-as-code, creates the volume and generated public domain.
